items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
Master's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training
8 - 13 years of related experience.
Previous supervisory/managerial experience.
Understanding of student development theory and application to student engagement
Experience working with multiple constituencies, including service providers, senior leadership, students and community
Relevant experience associated with managing facilities or programs associated with similar student-focused facilities in a university environment
Knowledge of best practices and industry standards associated with facilities management

Manages, plans and administers administrative operations and/or general operations of a school, OR college, OR a large interdisciplinary department within a school OR a large or multiple-department, non-academic unit. (35% time)

Serves as key administrative officer for unit's functional programs, oversees analysis and policy development for issues and processes. Develops, modifies, and executes organization policies which affect immediate operation(s). (20% time)

Administrative services typically include all or most of the following functions: IT, facilities, student services, laboratories, contracts and grants, budgetary financial management, recharge administration and/or human resources. (10% time)

Responsible for the management of major capital planning on behalf of the HUB and Costo Hall, providing expert level consultation on renovation, modification and expansion projects. Provides financial analysis, best practices, comparative analysis and communication plan regarding all projects associated with the HUB (10% time)
Maintains integrity of an organizational department through management and oversight of staff. (5% time)

Makes decisions on administrative or operational matters and ensures achievement of objectives (operational and budget processes, academic and/or staff FTE, finance, human resources, IT and space planning) that have department-wide impact. (5% time)

Interacts with higher-level management on controversial situations, customer negotiations, and/or influencing and persuading others. Formulates policies and guidelines to carry out the department's mission for faculty and students. (5% time)

Collaborate and maintain active engagement with campus service providers (Dining, Basic Needs and others) that operate programs and services within the Student Union. Provide direct customer service support and meet regularly to ensure alignment with expectations of service (5% time)
Other duties as necessary. (5% time)
Read/Comprehend: Constantly
Write: Constantly
Perform Calculations: Occasionally
Communicate Orally: Constantly
Reason & Analyze: Constantly
Bend: Occasionally
Sit: Constantly
Squat: Occasionally
Stand: Frequently
Walk: Frequently
Excellent ability to establish metrics for department and employee goals.
Thorough knowledge of common organization-specific and other computer application programs.
Excellent project management skills, including the capability of managing capital projects.
Understanding of student developmental theory, including engagement models and student development
Excellent skills to work collaboratively and act persuasively in sensitive situations; skills in conflict management techniques.
Ability to work in a fast paced environment and respond quickly to emerging needs
Thorough knowledge of financial analysis and reporting techniques; human resources and risk management planning; accounting and payroll.
Excellent ability to manage student fees, including coordinating with student-led governing board, transparency and thoughtful engagement with broader student community
Excellent interpersonal skills to effectively lead, motivate and influence others and to develop and maintain high standards of customer service.
Strong ability to understand and utilize policies/procedures when evaluating events and other issues
Very strong ability to quickly evaluate complex issues and identify multiple options for resolution.
High level of political acumen and understanding of how to navigate complex institutional environments
Knowledgeable regarding best practices in facilities management, including deferred maintenance, renovations and expansion
